notes.title: SaveData Compatibility
notes.notes:
[p]When playing in Chinese or Korean, we have discovered that save data is not compatible between Version 1.1 and Version 1.2.
To address this, we have opened a beta branch that allows you to temporarily play Version 1.1.
By accessing Version 1.1 through the beta branch, you will be able to use your previous save data.[/p][p]To use the beta branch, please open [b]Properties → Betas[/b] from the Steam client’s product page and enter the following code:
[b]StellarCode11[/b][/p][p]We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by not realizing that save data could not be loaded.[/p][p][b]Note:[/b] This branch is intended for players using the Chinese or Korean versions. It is not designed for Japanese players to downgrade. In addition, this beta branch is only provided as a temporary downgrade option and is scheduled for removal within this year. From next year onward, please use the new version.[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.2 Release
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Even when Japanese is selected in the language settings, Simplified Chinese and Korean can now also be chosen from Config.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Auto mode and Skip mode would stop during certain scenes.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected typos, misspellings, and furigana.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1 Release
notes.notes: Fix the issue that the ending cut scene is not shown correclty in specific environments including SteamDeck.

notes.title: Stellar Code launches on August 15!
notes.notes: [p]You are about to unravel an [b]unbelievable mystery[/b].[/p][p]While this is a mystery-themed visual novel, it differs from conventional mysteries — there are no culprits to catch or tricks to deduce.[/p][p]The mystery you must solve is one rooted in the [b]cosmos and theoretical physics[/b].[/p][p]From the creators of [i]The Witch of Toyotoki[/i], a doujin visual novel that has sold over [b]30,000 copies[/b], comes a [b]new era of sci-fi mystery[/b].[/p][p]Estimated playtime: [b]5–7 hours[/b].[/p][p]Get ready for the release of a bold new science fiction mystery.[/p][p][/p][p]We really want to support English version. Now looking for a translation partner.[/p]

notes.title: Demo V4.0
notes.notes: [p]Some of the puzzles have been adjusted. (These changes apply to the Japanese version only.)[/p][p]Starting with this version, the in-game language selection feature has been removed. To play in a language other than Japanese, please change your Steam language setting and download the game again.[/p][p]Please note that save data from previous versions is not compatible.[/p]

notes.title: Stellar Code Demo V3.0 (Korean Support)
notes.notes:
We added a new language support - Korean!  Please, have a fun!

We are still seeking a partner for English support.
